description: This file defines a wizard interface for setting filter fields in the base_report_creator module of an Odoo/OpenERP system, including form layouts, domain setting, operator selection, and filter application logic.

classes.name: set_filter_fields
classes.description: A wizard interface class for configuring report filter fields with multiple states for domain setting, form input, and filter application.

methods.name: _set_field_domain
methods.description: Sets the domain for selecting a filter field based on the current model and context.

methods.name: set_field_operator
methods.description: Determines the appropriate search operator and value formatting based on field type and user input.

methods.name: _set_filter_value
methods.description: Creates a filter record in the database based on user-selected field, operator, and value.

methods.name: _set_form_value
methods.description: Prepares form data for filter value input based on selected field.

methods.name: _set_operator
methods.description: Populates the list of available operators based on the field type.
